issues.description: Drilling a hole with a 2D `at` and direction -y starts from the +Y side, so the hole at z=20 drilled through the hook's vertical rod (reported depth 46.75) instead of only the plate. Had to use a 3D start point on the front face (y=5) with depth=5. The 2D-at 'first enters material' rule is surprising when another feature is in the path.
Plate-front countersinks drilled from the +Y side need a note on how to restrict them to one feature when the part has other geometry in the drilling line.
cad measure --holes reports countersunk holes as plain d=4.5 with a depth of 2.75 and position y=0; it does not show the countersink diameter/angle or the entry face.

A 2D `at` with direction='-y' and no depth drills through everything, including the hook rod rising behind the plate at the same X/Z (hole at z=20 cut through the vertical rod at y=45). The 2D 'first enters material' rule plus 'through everything' is easy to misuse when other features sit in line behind the plate. I only noticed because measure --holes reported depth 46.7.
Hole 'position' in measure --holes is reported at y=0 (the back face) with axis +Y, depth 2.7 for a countersunk 5 mm plate; the depth semantic (excludes countersink?) is not documented.

Hole direction semantics for a countersink on the +Y (front) face: had to infer that direction='-y' drills from the +Y side and puts the countersink on the front. Table helps but a plate-on-wall example would be clearer.
measure --holes reports hole depth 3.0 and position y=0 for a countersunk hole in a 5 mm plate, without mentioning the countersink dimensions; hard to verify countersink diameter numerically.

suggestions.suggestion: Warn when a hole drilled from a 2D `at` passes through unexpectedly large material (e.g. depth far larger than the nearest wall).
Allow holes() to take a target feature or face (e.g. on=plate.front) to limit where they start.
Warn when a through hole cuts a feature other than the one it enters (or add a 'stop at first exit' option).
Document sweep profile orientation for a path starting along +Y (circle is symmetric so it did not matter here).
Report countersink/counterbore diameter and angle in measure --holes.
Add a wall-plate-with-hook recipe using Path.polyline(radius=).
